response.courseDescription: 477 Human Health Behavior and Behavioral Interventions Analysis of health-related behaviors and the social, cultural, and environmental context in which they occur; examines how psychological and behavioral traits shape individual-level patterns of physical activity, diet, and health; explores how behavior change theories are used to develop health interventions for individuals and application in clinical and community settings.
